description: New Agent wizard starters. The 'Build your own agent' walkthrough is pre-cached against these EXACT definitions (scripts/build-starter-cache.mjs): a judge who creates a starter unchanged and runs it gets a real cached LLM result key-free; any edit honestly switches the run to live/deterministic. Do not edit text fields without rebuilding the starter cache.

starters.title: Blank canvas
starters.blurb: A minimal agent you wire up yourself in the builder.

definition.description: A new agent built in the studio.

agent.instruction: Summarize the key clinical facts for this patient and suggest next steps.

starters.title: Allergy documentation audit
starters.blurb: Checks a chart for missing or unsafe allergy documentation and drafts a Task. Uses a custom output schema - the shape you see is the shape it defines.

definition.description: Check whether the patient has allergy information documented and flag charts with gaps or conflicts.

agent.instruction: Audit this chart for allergy documentation: is an allergy status recorded at all, are listed allergies specific and coded, and could any active medication conflict with a listed allergy? Flag exactly what is missing or risky.

starters.title: Discharge medication counselling
starters.blurb: Writes plain-language medication counselling for a recently discharged patient, grounded in the drug-guidance corpus via vector search.

definition.description: Plain-language counselling notes for every active medication after discharge - what it is for, how to take it, and what to watch for.

agent.instruction: For each ACTIVE medication, write 1-2 plain sentences of counselling for the patient: what it is for, how to take it, and the single most important thing to watch for - grounded in the supplied drug guidance. Note anything the prescriber should double-check.

starters.title: Metformin renal safety
starters.blurb: Checks kidney function against active metformin using a custom eGFR query, the drug-guidance corpus via vector search, and a purpose-built output contract - then drafts a prescriber Task. The walkthrough agent from the build-it-yourself video.

definition.description: Monitor renally-cleared medications - especially metformin - against the patient's latest kidney function and draft a prescriber review when a threshold is crossed.

agent.instruction: Review this patient's kidney function against their active medications - especially metformin. Using the latest eGFR and the retrieved renal dosing guidance, decide for each renally-cleared medication whether it is safe at the current kidney function, needs a dose review, or is contraindicated. Cite the specific eGFR value and the guidance threshold, and recommend the concrete next step for the prescriber.
